prepared_storage_variant.purpose: Plan-owned scratch sized by maximum radix of existing cold kf_factor; all generic butterfly arithmetic unchanged. Child recursion finishes before parent butterfly scratch use. Admission bounded by N<=min(configured cap,16384), real even N>=2/complex N>=1; out-of-place only. No generic hot allocation, TLS or shared scratch.
